content.title: Sixers at Spurs: Game Preview, Injury Report and How to Watch | Apr. 6, 2026
content.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (43-35) will begin their final road trip of the regular season Monday at 8 p.m. ET against the San Antonio Spurs (59-19).The Spurs lost 136-134 in overtime to the Denver Nuggets on Saturday. Victor Wembanyama had 34 points, 18 rebounds, seven assists and five blocks, while Denver’s Nikola Jokić finished with 40 points, eight rebounds, 13 assists and three blocks.Later Saturday, the Sixers fell 116-93 to the Detroit Pistons without Joel Embiid. Seven Pistons scored in double figures as they clinched the No. 1 seed in the Eastern Conference.San Antonio won the first meeting between the teams, 131-91, on March 3 in Philadelphia. Dylan Harper and Devin Vassell each scored 22 points for the Spurs, while Tyrese Maxey had 21 for the Sixers.Here are the RAV4 Things to Know ahead of Monday’s game:Standings UpdateThe Sixers moved back into sixth place in the Eastern Conference after Toronto’s loss Sunday in Boston.Maxey vs. Spurs In his last three games against San Antonio, Maxey is averaging 35.0 points, 7.6 rebounds and 5.6 assists, including a 52-point road performance on April 7, 2024.PG Lately In six games since returning to the lineup, Paul George is averaging 25.8 points, 6.5 rebounds, 4.0 assists and 3.0 steals.George is shooting 44.1% from 3-point range on 9.8 attempts per game during that span.Tonight’s UniformsThe Sixers will wear their red Statement Edition uniforms. The Spurs are scheduled to wear their black Icon Edition uniforms.Injury Report76ersJohni Broome (right knee surgery recovery) – OutCameron Payne (right hamstring strain) – OutSpursDavid Jones Garcia (right ankle surgery) – OutHow to Watch and ListenDate: Monday, April 6Time: 8 p.m. ETLocation: Frost Bank Center, San AntonioTV: NBC Sports PhiladelphiaRadio: 97.5 The Fanatic; 76ers Mobile AppFollow the Sixers
